stem:
The chemical formula for methane is CH₄.

Which statement describes the atoms present in FOUR molecules of methane?

options.label: A
options.text: Four molecules of methane would contain 1 atom of carbon and 4 atoms of hydrogen.

options.label: B
options.text: Four molecules of methane would contain 4 atoms of carbon and 1 atom of hydrogen.

options.label: C
options.text: Four molecules of methane would contain 4 atoms of carbon and 16 atoms of hydrogen.

options.label: D
options.text: Four molecules of methane would contain 16 atoms of carbon and 16 atoms of hydrogen.
